# `sharpelab_nb.drivers` API Reference

Instrument drivers in `src/sharpelab_nb/drivers/`, re-exported from the package:

```python
from sharpelab_nb.drivers import SRS_DC205, Yokogawa7651, ANC350
```

The `drivers` package (`src/drivers/`: `FastBi1K5`, `QSwitch`, `ContactMux`,
the VTI `SRS_DC205`, …) is documented separately in
[`drivers.md`](drivers.md).

---

## `SRS_DC205` — DC voltage source (fixed-duration ramp)

`SRS_DC205(name, address, *, ramp_num_points=100, ramp_wait_time=0.01, **kwargs)`.
Serial `VisaInstrument` (115200 baud).

| parameter | unit | R/W | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voltage` | V | R/W | raw setpoint (7 dp) |
| `smart_voltage` | V | R/W | set → `ramp_voltage` |
| `voltage_range` | — | R/W | 0: ±1 V, 1: ±10 V, 2: ±100 V |
| `output` | 0/1 | R/W | output enable |

- **`ramp_voltage(volt)`** — software ramp from the current reading over
  `ramp_num_points` steps spaced `ramp_wait_time` apart (so the duration is
  roughly fixed regardless of ΔV), **plus a mandatory 10 s settle when
  `|Δvolt| > 0.1 V`**. (The VTI `drivers.SRS_DC205` of the same name uses
  rate-based (`ramp_rate` V/s) semantics and has no fixed settle — they are not
  interchangeable.)

---

## `Yokogawa7651` — programmable DC source (pre-SCPI, write-only cached)

`Yokogawa7651(name, address, *, coil_constant=None, **kwargs)`. The 7651 is
pre-SCPI (no `*IDN?`) and cannot report programmed values back over the bus, so
**all set parameters are write-only with a software cache**.

| parameter | unit | R/W | range / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `volt` | V | W | ±30 V |
| `current` | A | W | ±0.12 A |
| `field` | T | W | requires `coil_constant=`; range = ±0.12·|coil| |
| `mode` | — | W | `'VOLT'` (F1;) / `'CURR'` (F5;) |
| `output` | bool | W | output enable |

- After a kernel restart the cache is empty, so the ramp methods raise unless
  the cache is seeded first: **`set_voltage_cache(value)`** /
  **`set_current_cache(value)`**, or pass `start=` to the ramp call.
- **`ramp_voltage(target, step=0.01, delay=0.05, start=None)`** /
  **`ramp_current(target, step=0.001, delay=0.05, start=None)`** — software ramp
  from the cached (or `start=`) value; `step` must be `> 0`.
- When `coil_constant` is given, `field.step`/`field.inter_delay` are
  pre-configured for safe ramping (0.1 mT / 0.1 s ⇒ ~1 mT/s).
- `trigger()` sends `E;` (normally automatic after each set). `get_idn()`
  returns a static dict.

---

## `ANC350` — attocube piezo motion controller (rotator)

`ANC350(name, dll_dir, *, device_no=0, num_axes=3, **kwargs)`. Loads
`anc350v2.dll`/`libusb0.dll` from `dll_dir`; exposes `num_axes` axes as a
`ChannelTuple` at `.axes` (each an `ANC350Axis`).

### `ANC350Axis` (one stepper axis)
| parameter | unit | R/W | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | — | R | raw status int (decode via `is_moving`/`is_at_eot`/`has_sensor_error`/`is_sensor_disconnected`) |
| `position` | counts | R | raw sensor int32 (INT32_MAX when sensor power is off — the toploader default) |
| `rotation_count` | — | R | full-rotation counter |
| `amplitude` | mV | R/W | step drive amplitude, 0–70 000 |
| `frequency` | Hz | R/W | step frequency, 1–2000 |
| `dc_level` | mV | R/W | constant DC for fine positioning (output must be enabled) |
| `output_enabled` | bool | W | HV output; reads a software tri-state cache (True/False/None) — `set_output_cache()` to seed after restart |

Methods: `step(direction, count=1, *, wait=True, timeout=60.0, poll_interval=0.05)`
(±1 = forward/backward), `step_continuous(direction)`, `stop()`,
`wait_until_idle(…)`. `step`/`step_continuous` refuse to run unless the output
cache is `True`.

---

## Lock-in servo (`lockin_servo`)

Closed-loop positioning of an `ANC350Axis` against a lock-in voltage readback.
Not re-exported from the package — import from
`sharpelab_nb.drivers.lockin_servo`.

### `bring_up_servo_axis(name, axis, readback, *, amplitude_mv=60_000, frequency_hz=100, direction_sign=None, settle_time=0.5, v_min=-50e-3, v_max=+50e-3, tolerance=25e-6, max_iterations=200, step_count=1)` → `LockinServoedAxis`
One-call bring-up: set amplitude/frequency, enable HV output, resolve
`direction_sign` (if `None`, **physically steps the rotator** via
`calibrate_direction_sign` and prints the result to cache), and construct the
servo. `amplitude_mv` is millivolts (60 000 = 60 V).

### `LockinServoedAxis(name, *, axis, readback, direction_sign, v_min, v_max, tolerance=25e-6, settle_time=0.5, max_iterations=200, step_count=1)`
| parameter | unit | R/W | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voltage` | V | R | one-shot read of the underlying readback |
| `target_voltage` | V | R/W | **set runs the servo loop synchronously**; get = last target (or None) |
| `last_iterations` | — | R | iterations used by the last run |
| `last_residual` | V | R | `abs(target − final)` of the last run |

`set` of `target_voltage` raises `ServoTimeout` if `max_iterations` is exceeded.
`abort()` requests the in-progress loop to stop (does not call `axis.stop()`).
`direction_sign` and `axis` are properties.

### `thermalized_setpoint(servo, readback_lockin, *, name=None, full_amp=None, off_amp=0.004, wait_s=60.0)` → `Parameter`
Wrap a servo move + sensor-excitation cool-down into one settable-only
`Parameter` (use as a sweep's slow axis): restore excitation → servo to target
→ drop excitation to `off_amp` → wait `wait_s` for the stage to thermalize.
After each set the lock-in amplitude is left at `off_amp`, so the followed
readback is noise during the read window — the meaningful axis is the setpoint.

### `calibrate_direction_sign(axis, readback, *, settle_time, noise_samples=5, noise_threshold=None, max_test_steps=10)` → `(sign, n_steps)`
Resolve step polarity empirically: issue forward steps until `readback` moves
past the noise threshold, return `+1` if it rose else `-1` (with the step count
used). `settle_time` is required. Called automatically by `bring_up_servo_axis`
when `direction_sign=None`.

"""Runs 6 + 7 (sdh-spot-check, e and h side at D = 0): raw R(B), background-subtracted
oscillations, FFT in 1/B, onset. Scratch first."""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_fft, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError, luttinger_frequency

here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
out = {}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for j, (rid, n12) in enumerate([(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r = open_run(here / "data" / str(rid))
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I
    T = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I, T = B[o], R[o], I[o], T[o]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    print(f"\n=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.2f}e12, F_L(full, 4-fold) = {FL:.1f} T; T {T.min():.3f}-{T.max():.3f} K; "
          f"I_drain {I.min()*1e9:.2f}-{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA; R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm")
    # point-to-point scatter at low B (noise estimate)
    m = (B > 0.3) & (B < 1.0)
    d = np.diff(R[m]); print(f"  low-B (0.3-1 T) R med {np.median(R[m]):.1f}, pt-pt rms {np.std(d)/np.sqrt(2):.2f} Ohm")
    # filling factors at 10 T
    nB = abs(n12) * 1e16 / (10.0 * 1.602e-19 / 6.626e-34) ; print(f"  nu at 10 T = {nB:.1f}; nu at 5 T = {2*nB:.1f}")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.8); ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw |Rxx|"); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("R (Ohm)")
    # 1/B plot with 4-fold LL index guide
    m = B > 1.0
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], R[m], lw=0.8); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("R (Ohm)")
    for nu in range(4, 80, 4):
        b = abs(n12) * 1e16 * 6.626e-34 / (nu * 1.602e-19)
        if 1.0 < b < 10: ax[1, j].axvline(1 / b, color="0.8", lw=0.5)
    ax[1, j].set_title("vs 1/B; grey = 4-fold LL fillings nu = 4k at the nominal n")
    for b_lo in (1.5, 2.5):
        try:
            freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(b_lo, 10.0), nfft=2048, bg_degree=3, log=False)
            sp = spec[0]; fm = (freqs > 2) & (freqs < 120)
            pk = freqs[fm][np.argsort(sp[fm])[::-1][:6]]
            print(f"  FFT window {b_lo}-10 T (bg deg 3, linear R): top peaks {np.round(np.sort(pk),1)} T")
            ax[2, j].plot(freqs, sp / sp[fm].max(), label=f"{b_lo}-10 T")
        except Exception as e:
            print("  fft fail", e)
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", label=f"F_L 4-fold {FL:.1f} T"); ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 2, color="r", ls=":", label="F_L/2")
    ax[2, j].set_xlim(0, 80); ax[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7); ax[2, j].set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B")
    try:
        so = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=1.0, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9, bg_degree=3)
        print(so.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("  onset:", e)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(here / "hera_scratch" / "spot67_raw_fft.png", dpi=110)
print("saved")

Auto-adjust SR830 sensitivity based on current reading vs. range.

    Checks the phase of the current-measuring SR830 to verify valid
    measurement conditions, then iterates through the other lock-ins
    and adjusts sensitivity up or down as needed.

    Waits 10x the time constant between sensitivity changes per the
    SR830 manual guidelines.

    Args:

        lower_lim: Minimum sensitivity threshold. Won't decrement below this.

## Discriminants (what the data has to show)

| observable | ABAB (Bernal) | ABCA (rhombohedral) | ABCB (mixed) |
|---|---|---|---|
| bands at D = 0 | two bilayer-like parabolic bands, light + heavy (m* ≈ 0.03 / 0.06 mₑ); semimetallic overlap | one very flat quartic band (m* large near CNP), 16-fold zero-energy LL manifold | no inversion symmetry → intrinsic gap at D = 0 (~10 meV class), monolayer-like + bilayer-like pieces |
| Landau fan at D = 0 | two fans (two SdH frequencies with F₁+F₂ = F_L) → LL crossings / beating; lowest gaps at ν = ±4 (8-fold zero LL per block, blocks offset) | single fan, first gaps at ν = ±8 (16-fold zero LL) then interaction-split; LL energies ∝ B² at low index | Dirac-like √B ladder + parabolic ladder, ν = 0 gapped at all B, e/h asymmetric |
| R_CNP vs D at B = 0 | weak, slow gap opening; symmetric in ±D | strong exponential gap opening, symmetric in ±D | gap already at D = 0, **asymmetric** in ±D |
| T-dependence of R_CNP | metallic/semimetallic (weak) | insulating at finite D, activated | insulating at D = 0 |

## Steps

0. **Gate C — liveness / leakage** (`gate-current-sanity-check`) — DONE, runs 0–3. Alive, 60–330 Ω, no leakage. Two series CNPs (regions A, B).
1. **0 T gatemap → CNP + (n, D) calibration** (`gatemap`, `cnp-and-dline-calibration`) — DONE, run 5 (run 4 railed). Ratio c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior — *absolute scale unverified*), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm. Region B parallel ridge, +0.43×10¹² electron-doped. R_CNP(D): 297 Ω at D ≈ 0 → 2.4 kΩ at +0.25 V/nm, only −0.08…+0.30 V/nm covered.
2. **Feasibility model** — DONE (in the run-6 proposing markdown): model SdH frequencies per stacking at the spot densities.
3. **SdH spot checks e/h at D = 0** (`sdh-spot-check`) — DONE, runs 6 (0 → 10 T) and 7 (10 → 0.3 T). QH regime from ~2 T; dominant 7.1–7.4 T tone on both sides (n-independent — light band or ungated region), n-dependent content too. Not a read by itself.
4. **Landau fan at D = 0** (`landau-fan`) — **NEXT** (operator request). Fast: n = −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² along the calibrated D = 0 line (131 pts, Δn = 0.035×10¹², TG −0.291…+0.998 V, BG −0.484…+1.185 V — TG-limited both ends). Slow: B 0.4 → 10 T in 0.2 T (49 rows). sr1 100 µV (10 kΩ FS; the ν = 0 state at high B may rail — accepted, the rail is itself a read). ≈ 3h20m priced (1.10 s/pt from run 5; 0.134 T/min from run 6), ends at 10 T.
   Establishes: (i) the LL fan slopes → **absolute n calibration** (ν = n h / eB fixes c_tg, closing step 1's open end); (ii) the degeneracy sequence out of the CNP (±4 vs ±8); (iii) whether the 7.2 T tone fans from the CNP (a band) or is a horizontal stripe (ungated region); (iv) crossings (two-band ABAB) vs a single fan; (v) e/h asymmetry.
5. **D-dependence at high B** (ride 10 T down): (n, D) map at fixed B = 10 T over the validator box, or a D-sweep at the CNP — the ν = 0 / small-ν gaps vs D discriminate ABAB (weak) from ABCA (strong layer-polarized) from ABCB (asymmetric). Design after step 4's read. ~1.5–2 h.
6. **R_CNP(D) at B = 0 across ±D symmetrically** and/or **T-dependence of R_CNP** (heater ladder ≤ 100 K, ratio 0.95) if the call still hinges on gap size/asymmetry. Optional; ~2 h.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² × B 0.4 → 10 T

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`), the operator's requested next move. Runs 6–7 (ana) put the device in the QH regime from ~2 T with Rxx minima at ≈ 0 Ω, but the two 1D cuts share a dominant **7.1–7.4 T tone that does not scale with n** (2.7× density change) alongside n-dependent content — a two-band (ABAB-type light band) reading and an ungated-region reading are indistinguishable in 1D. The fan separates them: gated bands fan out of the CNP, an ungated region is a horizontal stripe. It also (i) fixes the **absolute density scale** from the LL slopes ν = nh/eB (c_tg is still the 9.5 nm prior), (ii) reads the degeneracy sequence out of the CNP (±4 vs ±8), (iii) shows crossings (two bands) vs a single fan, (iv) e/h asymmetry. **Design:** fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line, n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² in 131 pts (Δn 0.035×10¹² ≈ 9.9 mV TG; ≥ 5.6 pts per 4-fold gap above 2 T, 28 at 10 T); slow = B 0.4 → 10 T in 0.2 T, 49 rows, uniform in B so LL lines are straight. **Coverage trade:** the hole side stops at −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) vs +3.25 on the electron side — the D = 0 line is TG-limited at both ends, nothing more is reachable without leaving D = 0; the B range starts at 0.4 T (below ~1.5 T there are no oscillations at this T_e). Si held at 0 V. sr1 fixed at 100 µV (10 kΩ FS — run 5 read 50 Ω features at this range; the ν = 0 state at high B may exceed it → flat top at the CNP only, accepted as a "> 10 kΩ" read). Dwell fast_delay 1 s / slow_delay 3 s as run 5 (lag ≲ 1 step, uniform per row); the magnet's 3 s settle per row is inside the blocking set. Guards: interrupt on |I_gate| > 1 nA or T_sample > 2 K. **Price** (run 5: 1.10 s/pt; run 6: 0.134 T/min): 49 × 131 × 1.10 s = 118 min + 10 T ramp 75 min + row overhead ~8 min ≈ 3h20m; realistic ≈ 3h35m. Ends at **10 T** with the gates at the fan's end point; step 5 rides the magnet down. **Checkpoints:** first row (~4 min: signal level, rail at the CNP?, gate currents, B readback tracking); then at rows ~10 (2.2 T), ~25 (5.2 T), ~40 (8.2 T) re-form the partial fan — continue if LL lines fan from a common CNP; stop and rethink if the map is featureless or dominated by n-independent stripes.
